risks.note: The Executive Director & CEO, Mr. Arjun Ananth, resigned effective 25 October 2025, and two other Board members (Mrs. P J Bhavani, non-executive director, and Mr. Gautam Shahi, independent director) also resigned before year-end, during the same year the Company was reshaping its portfolio and building a new healthcare platform.
risks.risk: Leadership and key-management turnover during the transformation year

risks.note: The Company states it is redeploying capital from monetisation of legacy assets, with discipline, into healthcare; continued funding of its healthcare foray is thus tied to cash generation from its legacy real-estate operations rather than from the healthcare businesses themselves.
risks.risk: Dependence on legacy real-estate monetisation to fund the healthcare pivot

risks.note: The Company completed majority-stake acquisitions in three separate healthcare entities (Biohygea Global, Optimus Oncology and 7Med India) within the same financial year while also operating existing subsidiaries and step-down subsidiaries, creating execution risk in integrating a newly assembled multi-entity platform.
risks.risk: Integration risk from multiple, near-simultaneous acquisitions

risks.note: The Company describes itself as transforming from a diversified legacy business into an integrated healthcare platform across four new pillars (Cancer Care, Renal Care, Senior Care, Women's Health/Diagnostics) — a change in the nature of operations that carries execution and demand-realisation risk distinct from its historical business.

Safetrunk Services Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, was struck off from the Registrar of Companies' records with effect from 1 July 2025 during the year under review, reducing and reshaping the Company's subsidiary base.
